title: Code and data for: Resonant enhancement and source priors shape subwavelength acoustic reconstruction
description: Companion code, measurements, frozen inputs, Source Data and validation for the amended manuscript submitted on 17 November 2026. Includes the exact main PDF (29 pages), Supplement PDF (27 pages), original submitted Overleaf project, five main figures, eight supplementary figures, Supplementary Notes 1–16 and one table. Numerical inputs and eighteen prior checkpoints are unchanged from v1.0.0.
